content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"project member who reviews task reports","i_want":"to download the current task report view as an Excel file","so_that":"I can share or analyse the filtered and sorted task data outside the application","business_description":"Users can export the task report data to Excel. The exported file contains only the rows that match the currently applied filters, in the currently applied sort order. The file has clear column headers, one consistent date format, and a file name that includes the generation timestamp. If there is no data to export, the user sees a message and no file is produced.","business_value":"Users can take task report data out of the application for sharing and offline analysis, and the exported data matches what they see on screen.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task report with at least one row is displayed","when":"the user selects the Export to Excel action","then":"an Excel file is downloaded to the user's device"},{"given":"a task report with filters and a sort order applied","when":"the user exports the report to Excel","then":"the file contains only the rows matching the applied filters, in the same order as the applied sort"},{"given":"an exported Excel file with date columns","when":"the file is opened","then":"the header row has a label for every column and every date column uses the same date format"},{"given":"a user exports the report at a known generation time","when":"the file is downloaded","then":"the file name contains the timestamp of the generation time"},{"given":"the current filters return zero rows","when":"the user selects the Export to Excel action","then":"no file is downloaded and a message informing the user that there is no data to export is shown"},{"given":"the team has recorded its decision on where the Excel file is generated","when":"the user exports the report","then":"the file content and file name are the same whichever side generates the file"}],"edge_cases":["Filters return zero rows: no file is produced and a message is shown.
